status: frozen_before_formal stimulus rendering and SparseDrive inference
purpose: Test whether one fixed camera-only planning receiver preserves and directionally mitigates a preregistered separated-boundary-overlap ordering for a designed opposing-path actor in scene-0041.
claim_boundary: At most this experiment can support a scene-, receiver-, path-, asset- and phase-grid-specific task-response claim. It cannot establish lane legality, real-world safety margins, actor behaviour realism, matched real-sim equivalence, collision probability, closed-loop safety or general HUGSIM credibility.

simulator.name: HUGSIM
simulator.mode: open-loop exact released metadata camera poses

receiver.name: SparseDrive-S Stage2
receiver.role: fixed target AD receiver, not simulator truth

intervention.changed_across_conditions: actor arrival timestamp at the fixed conflict centre only
held_fixed: actor asset, dimensions, speed, heading, height offset and spatial corridor
all 180 released timestamps and six-camera intrinsics and poses
background checkpoint and native scene dynamics
receiver weights, history frames, command, ego state and planning horizon

qualified_instruments.footprint_limit: ego dimensions are HUGSIM internal defaults and actor dimensions are the pinned RealCar asset; neither is independent real-world geometry truth

formal_input_gate.failure_rule: If any condition has no visible support at frame 48, materially mismatched projection, changed held-fixed camera inputs, incomplete actor states or a failed geometry order, stop before SparseDrive inference.

special_branches.entry_only_after_3s_horizon: categorical result with c=null unless an explicit longer future qualifies it

receiver_outcomes.primary: For the selected native plan, recompute conflict-region occupancy relative to the same actor future and report conflict mitigation relative to the fixed released ego reference path.
secondary: selected planning mode and score margin
all six fixed-mode trajectories without behavioural names
whether the plan spatially avoids C or has a complete single occupancy interval
receiver_outcomes.directional_expectation: The overlap condition should not receive less conflict mitigation than boundary, and boundary should not receive less than separated, unless a documented planning-mode change supplies an alternative conflict-reducing explanation.
receiver_outcomes.discriminability: A claimed response must exceed the larger of the two-reset local repeat envelope and the 0.02 s geometry discretization bound.
receiver_outcomes.no_critical_object_claim: SparseDrive does not expose a qualified critical-object identity; no internal risk-ranking claim will be made.

evidence_labels_if_completed.dynamic_and_projection_transport: accepted only for gross simulator-internal contract checks
evidence_labels_if_completed.task_response: at most down-weighted because no matched real reference or externally qualified response magnitude exists
